name: Uta no Yobu Mono
source:
Client visits Detective Hayakawa and asks to investigate the truth behind his friend's suicide. How can this case be connected to the urban legend about a poem that causes brings death upon reading?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
委托人拜访早川侦探，请他调查朋友自杀背后的真相。这个案件与那则读到便会带来死亡的诗歌都市传说究竟有何关联？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
